_doc: Hand-kept data for the Layer and Backtest Map (scripts/dev/make_layer_map.py -> MyTradingSys/system/artifacts/layer_map.html). One row per backtest or study; one row per layer. A field the repo does not record is null and the page prints 'not recorded'; never fill a guess. 'read' says how much of the source report was read when the row was written: summary = verdict and method read; header = only the top of the file. Append rows; set asof when you touch the file. Params carry src: sourced (trader's own words), grid (swept in the run), NO-SOURCE (flagged by the provenance rule), code (taken from the repo default).
